headline: ECB Urges Banks to Review Governance Models for AI Control
summary: The European Central Bank called on banks to review their governance models to control artificial intelligence risks, warning that technological transformation could widen competitive gaps between large and small institutions.
why: Regulatory oversight by the ECB sets compliance standards for European financial institutions, impacting technology adoption costs and operational risks.

impacts.name: European Banking Sector
impacts.why: New AI governance mandates from the ECB require increased compliance spending across European banks.
